Note: Missing ANC values within the first 13 days of a cycle will be imputed using the method specified in SAP.

[1] The upper limit of the one-sided 97.5% CI is estimated by Hodges-Lehmann method for the difference in duration (day) of Grade 3 or 4 neutropenia between F-627 vs. GRAN®
